input.title: GestureMenu doesn't highlight all matching gestures for possible commands
input.body:
Original issue — no longer valid (click to expand)
## ~~Steps to Reproduce~~ ~~1. Ensure there are no thoughts (notably).~~ ~~2. Swipe → then ↓ and hold~~ ## ~~Current Behavior~~ ~~After the first swipe, the first segment of the New Thought Gesture Diagram is not highlighted.~~ ![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/c25795bb-b8dc-4dbb-a8c5-bd29f8ffa31e) ~~After the second swipe, neither of the first two segments of the New Thought gesture diagram are highlighted.~~ ![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/2b88b666-ac72-48f9-a487-61d89cc66cff) ## ~~Expected Behavior~~ ~~After the first swipe, the first segment should be highlighted.~~ ~~After the second swipe, the first and second segments should be highlighted.~~ [+]![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/f3be1510-3134-4d4b-ae9b-b366a5f935ca)
--- ## Steps to Reproduce 1. Swipe → then ↓ and hold ## Current Behavior Not all possible commands shown in the GestureMenu are highlighted according to the current gestures. In this case, **New Thought + Outdent** , **Notes** and **Table View**, don’t highlight their first two gestures. https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/e97da94a-e135-4e99-9eec-a0c0c40b59ab ## Expected Behavior All possible commands should highlight the current gestures accordingly.
